pages.title: Genetic Effects
pages.text: There are currently 6 identified Genes that can be implanted into humanoids. This entry will go over the effects and their benefits. Note that the potency of the effect for every gene goes up with high quality.

pages.title: Immortuos Gene
pages.text: The Gene for the parasite itself. Discovered while Rusk Co. was searching for a way to cohabitate with the parasite. This gene will slow down the infection, by confusing and killing small sections of the parasite as it tries to grow in its host.

pages.title: Zombie Gene
pages.text: Allows the user to hone into the Zombie's natural defenses. A small amount of natural armor is given to users of this genetic implant by hardening their bones.

pages.title: Ocelot Gene
pages.text: Also known as the Cat Gene, stimulates muscles in the legs to increase movement speed, if only slightly in the case of lower quality vials.

pages.title: Turtle Gene
pages.text: The user's skin under the effects of this gene will harden in any form of water, decreasing any external damage taken while in pools of water or the rain.

pages.title: Frog Gene
pages.text: Allows the user to squat down, and leap into their air higher than they otherwise could after doing so. This does not add fall damage resistance, however. Do be careful in using this one.

pages.title: Iron Golem Gene
pages.text: This gene activates a small rush of adrenaline to the arm muscles after taking damage, allowing the user to deal more damage for a few seconds.

pages.title: Silverfish Gene
pages.text: This gene enables and forces the host to produce enzymes that will chew up unnecessary bone material in the skeleton. This results in a shorter stature.

pages.title: Enderman Gene
pages.text: This gene creates a weak telepathic link with the world around the user, allowing them to interact with the world from further away. The user also inherits the Enderman's weakness to water, being exposed will temporarily remove the telepathic link, and weaken the user until dry.

pages.title: Vindicator Gene
pages.text: Spikes the user's adrenaline when killing something with an axe, increasing movement speed and attack swing speed for a short while, potentially dramatically.

pages.title: Wither Skeleton Gene
pages.text: When in the nether, the user harnesses the effects of the wither and applies it to attacked targets. This can be manifested elsewhere when at above 10 health and hunger. This gene increases hunger decrease rate by 25%

pages.title: Magma Cube Gene
pages.text: Coils the leg bones of the user similar to how a magma slime coils when crouching. If the user were to take fall damage while coiled, it is reduced. The energy from the fall is redirected from shattering your skeleton to a flaming pulse, radiating the fall damage removed from your fall as fire damage to all nearby entities.
